description: Lalpir Limited — Lalpir Power Limited until its 2026 change of name — was incorporated in 1994 and owned and operated a 362 MW fuel-fired power station at Mehmood Kot in Muzaffargarh, Punjab. Its principal activity is now to buy, sell, hold and invest in financial instruments, including shares, debentures, bonds, mutual fund and modaraba certificates, sukuk, term finance certificates and government securities.
sourceNote: The company's own PSX-filed half-yearly report to 30 June 2026 (company profile and registered office), the PSX company profile record, and the company website, read 2026-10-17.
